why: I checked both briefs against the two must_not items, and neither brief does either one. Item 1: the builder brief says to wrap only `JSON.parse` in try/catch and "On a parse error, rethrow. Do not return a value." It also lists returning `{}` or defaults as a non-goal. So it never tells the builder to catch the error and return a value. Item 2: verifier Check 2 passes when line 3 and column 3 appear "in a recognisable form (e.g. `line 3 column 3`, `3:3`, `line 3, column 3`)". It fails a run only when `bad config:`, the path, line 3 or column 3 is missing, or a different location is reported. The only exact match it requires is the path string, which the expect line also requires. Wording and order are not forced into one format, so the criterion holds.
